title: Manual door and gate access during outage
summary: A quick access card for electric gates, garage doors, apartment buzzers, lifts, shop shutters, and locked courtyards when power or electronics fail.
content: Core sequence: 1) Locate the manual release, physical key, backup exit, or responsible key holder before the outage becomes urgent. 2) Do not force motors, shutters, or gates while people are in the path of movement. 3) Keep one exit usable without electricity for children, older adults, wheelchairs, and emergency responders. 4) After manual opening, mark the gate or door status so nobody assumes the lock is still powered.
